definitions.de: Platz haben für; fassen (eine bestimmte Menge oder Anzahl aufnehmen können)
definitions.en: To fit/hold (a certain capacity or amount); to have room for
definitions.es: Caber; tener capacidad para (una cantidad determinada)
definitions.fr: Contenir; avoir de la place pour (une certaine capacité ou quantité)
definitions.hi: समाना; किसी निश्चित मात्रा या संख्या को धारण करना
definitions.ja: 収容できる；入る（ある量や人数が入るスペースがある）
definitions.km: អាចផ្ទុកបាន; មានទំហំគ្រប់គ្រាន់សម្រាប់ (បរិមាណ ឬចំនួនជាក់លាក់មួយ)
definitions.ko: 수용하다; (일정 용량이나 양을) 담을 수 있다
definitions.ne: अट्नु; (एक निश्चित मात्रा वा संख्या) समाउन सक्नु
definitions.pt: Caber; comportar (uma certa capacidade ou quantidade)
definitions.th: จุ; บรรจุได้ (ในปริมาณหรือจำนวนที่กำหนด)
definitions.tl: Kasya; makakaangkop ng (isang tiyak na kapasidad o dami)
definitions.ur: سمانا؛ کسی مخصوص مقدار یا تعداد کو رکھنے کی گنجائش ہونا
definitions.vi: Chứa được; có sức chứa (một lượng hoặc số lượng nhất định)
definitions.zh: 容纳；能装下（一定的容量或数量）
definitions.zh_Hant: 容納；能裝下（一定的容量或數量）

definition_en: To fit/hold (a certain capacity or amount); to have room for

lao_examples.lao_script: ຖົງໃບນີ້ຈຸຂອງໄດ້ຫຼາຍເລີຍ
lao_examples.romanization: thong bai nih ju khong dai lai loei
lao_examples.translation_en: This bag can hold a lot of stuff.

lao_examples.lao_script: ຫ້ອງນີ້ຈຸຄົນໄດ້ປະມານສິບຄົນ
lao_examples.romanization: hong nih ju khon dai pa-man sip khon
lao_examples.translation_en: This room can hold about ten people.
